data.long_meaning: In Roman mythology, Silvanus was the god of the forests, woods, and fields. He was also a protector of agricultural growth and rural life. In Christianity, Silvanus is venerated as a patron saint of forests and woodworkers. The name Silvan carries the meaning “Forest deity, protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Silvan usually hope their child will grow to embody forest deity, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
